title: Instagram refreshes its wordmark for the first time in a decade
question: How will Instagram users react to this over the first two weeks, which groups will push back and why, and is Instagram likely to keep, change or reverse the decision?

objections.text: The stylised 'r' looks like a 'z', so the name reads 'Instagzam'
The new lettering is harder to read and may hurt accessibility
It looks generic, like AI-generated text
Instagram should fix the feed instead of spending effort on branding

backdown.summary: Instagram's design leads defended the new wordmark and the rollout continued

notes: Mixed, meme-driven reaction rather than anger. A small survey showed most preferred the old mark, but the new one still rated about 3.8/5. A prediction of a firestorm followed by a reversal would be wrong.
